with.title: CMU ServerBench scores agents that build LLM serving stacks

possibilities.connection: On 2026-11-01 Magpie suggested inference buyers rerun hardware bake-offs because kernels swing cost per token; ServerBench now shows agent-built stacks beating the vLLM reference by 4.87x value per GPU dollar, and the final vLLM v0.33.0 tag fixes the gfx950 path, so software gaps are larger and the metric is standardized.

with.title: AMD MI355X reaches 2x B200 cost efficiency on Kimi K3
Agent swarm writes Hopper kernels for faster decode

possibilities.connection: AMD's 2x per-dollar claim depends on AITER tuning, vLLM v0.33.0 final ships a gfx950 AITER fix, and agent-written Hopper kernels add up to 38% decode speed, so software now moves the hardware ranking.

possibilities.title: Support teams can RL-tune and serve efficient Mamba hybrid agents on standard tooling

with.title: Hugging Face workshop on training agents with open weights
AsyncGRPO tree packing now trains hybrid attention models

possibilities.connection: The Hugging Face workshop teaches fine-tuning a small agent on traces, AsyncGRPO tree packing now runs RL on hybrid models such as Nemotron 3.5 Mamba2, and the vLLM release candidate follows a Mamba2 NaN output fix on sm90.
